You see Oblivis.
  • Did I feed the owls today? Wait, do I have owls?
  • Where did I put my fishing rod again?
  • Ah, nevermind...
  • Why do I feel like I forgot something important again?
  • Why do I keep forgetting it? Ehmm are my spells getting too strong?

Location

Westernmost peninsula of the Thais Surroundings.

Notes

He was once a member of the Noodles Academy of Modern Magic, but was expelled. His forgetting-spells can help people replay some quests for the alternative achievements.

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Oblivis.

Player: hi
Oblivis: Greetings, adventurer! How can I help you?
Player: name
Oblivis: The name's Oblivis, how may I assist you adventurer?
Player: quest
Oblivis: I don't have a quest for you exactly. Though I could help you replay certain experiences with the help of my spell.
Player: replay
Oblivis: Wouldn't it be nice to go back and do things differently? I might have the right spell that could help you with that.
Player: spell
Oblivis: What experience should I let people forget with my spell?
Player: Annihilator
Oblivis: I'm not able to help you with that. Come back when you're ready for more.
Player: owl
Oblivis: Do I even own an owl? Maybe I did in Edron, but I'm not quite sure.
Player: Edron
Oblivis: I once studied at the academy in Edron, though it not lasted for long, due to my ... well let's call them experiments.
Player: academy
Oblivis: In the east of Edron there are seven towers with each having their own floors and topics. I miss my time there, but now it's all past.
Player: experiments
Oblivis: It all started with just a minor forgetting-spell. But then... well, people started forgetting entire weeks.
Player: library
Oblivis: The library in the academy houses some very interesting book about magic, runes and manipulation.
Player: magic
Oblivis: My interest in magic and everything alike spiked when gundralph first introduced me to the sheer amount it can do.
Player: memory
Oblivis: Memories are easy to lose, hard to keep, maybe I could assist you in making someone forget? Did that spark your interest?
Player: forget
Oblivis: Fortunately for you I specialise in making people forget, such an underrated spell. Could that be interesting for you?.
Player: banned
Oblivis: The academy got hold of how dangerous my kinds of spells can get. Soon after my final experiment, I got expelled and banned from ever entering again.
Player: expelled
Oblivis: I can understand why I got expelled, it didn't stop me from crafting stronger and more potent versions of my spells. Are you interested in making them forget?
Player: return
Oblivis: I've often thought about returning to the academy ... I doubt they'd even remember me.
Player: school
Oblivis: I once studied at the academy in Edron, but that didn't last long after one of my experiment went wrong. Now this camp is what I call home!
Player: camp
Oblivis: My camp has everything I'd ever wish for. Here I can finally experiment without someone constantly watching my back.
Player: boat
Oblivis: I sail where ever it pleases me. I can finally feel free and travel all over beautiful Tibia.
Player: Alexander
Oblivis: He was one off my suppliers, they made all my experiments possible. Though I think one of them might have reported my activities to academy administration.
Player: Arkulius
Oblivis: Oh yeah, I remember him. He was so obsessed with solving the problem of this frozen mage, is that still what he's doing?
Player: yes
Oblivis: Why doesn't that suprise me?
Player: Eliza
Oblivis: She's responsable for the party spells, she's quite the party animal, but don't tell anybody.
Player: Fernlor
Oblivis: Fernlor always caught us doing magic training outside of the academy, I still don't know how he got us all these times.
Player: Fiona
Oblivis: If you ever need space in your backpack, she will take care of buying everything you might not need anymore.
Player: Gnomcruiter
Oblivis: Wasn't he always trying to recruit adventurer for the gnomish expedition corps. If you're into that, you should find him at the entrance of the academy, though.
Player: Gundralph
Oblivis: Ah, Gundralph my favorite! He sparked my passion for the the mystic arts. I owe him everything, really ... even the part that got me kicked out. I wonder if he still remembers me after everything.
Player: Lailene
Oblivis: I got my beloved rope from her, I always had a weird feeling about her though. Better not to think about it.
Player: Luna
Oblivis: Luna provided all sorts of herbs and plants for my experiments. Maybe I would still be part of the academy if my experiments hadn't worked so well...
Player: Milos
Oblivis: He taught me some things about theories. You know it's all about theories for him - everything, everyone, all the time - theories. Although he's very knowledgable it got nerve racking faster than I initially thought.
Player: Puffels
Oblivis: When I remember correctly it teaches some useful spells for knights.
Player: Sandra
Oblivis: She sold me a lot of potions during my time at the academy and I was fortunate enough to win the big prize at my first year of academy.
Player: Sinclair
Oblivis: I can only remember Sinclair's interest are because they starts with the same letter. He and Spectulus always had a thing for spirits - not really my thing, to be honest.
Player: Spectulus
Oblivis: He once told me a few things about astrology at the academy. Though I can't recall what it was about, stars are not really my thing. Sometimes he'd call me Jack for no resason.
Player: Thomas
Oblivis: He has all the books and parchment you could ever need. He's also great to joke around in the after hours.
Player: Ursula
Oblivis: Ah, the paladin trainer, I actually don't know if she still teaches them. We never had such pleasure in talking, or did we? I can't recall.
Player: Wyrdin
Oblivis: If you ever have a question about some research you should ask Wyrdin. He also knows a lot of people, maybe he has some adventures for you.
Player: Zoltan
Oblivis: He can teach some really strong and valuable spells, he's definitely worth a visit, if you ask me.
